s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your career and your goals.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1828186229000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
